name: consort
title: Consort
description: Control Consort stereo pairs, volume, balance, audio sources, and 1-click microphone sync. Requires the Consort macOS app.
author: nicolas_gavrilenko

commands.name: control-consort
commands.title: Control Consort
commands.description: Inspect your active stereo pair, volume, balance, and audio source, and control Consort.

commands.name: switch-audio-source
commands.title: Switch Audio Source
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Route all Mac audio or a specific app to your Consort stereo pair.

commands.name: toggle-stream
commands.title: Toggle Stereo Stream
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Start or stop Consort stereo streaming.

commands.name: toggle-mute
commands.title: Toggle Mute
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Mute or unmute Consort stereo output.

commands.name: volume-up
commands.title: Increase Volume
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Increase Consort stereo volume by one step.

commands.name: volume-down
commands.title: Decrease Volume
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Decrease Consort stereo volume by one step.

commands.name: set-volume
commands.title: Set Volume
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Set Consort stereo volume to a specific percentage (0 to 100).

commands.name: swap-speakers
commands.title: Swap Left and Right Speakers
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Swap the Left and Right channels of your active stereo pair.

commands.name: sync-audio
commands.title: Sync Audio
commands.subtitle: Consort
commands.description: Run 1-click microphone calibration to align speaker latency.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
